summary: Implement the first source-repo-backed Pro Select runtime with a separate Windows-facing `pros` CLI while preserving the existing Linux `oma` development workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: This repo gains a real source-level CLI/package structure for `pros`.
`pros` is modeled as a separate runtime entrypoint from `oma`.
The implementation treats the current working directory as a business workspace rather than the source repo.
V1 behavior stays focused on Pro Select-specific document and casework support.
The initial code path avoids Unix-only assumptions in Windows-facing runtime code.
The existing repo-local `oma` development flow remains intact.
assumptions: There is currently no package.json or existing CLI package in this repo, so scaffolding a new source package is in scope.
The first implementation should prioritize a vertical slice over a complete end-user product.
Windows runtime behavior applies to `pros`, not to the repo's authoring workflow.
The active business workspace may be a case folder, document folder, invoice folder, or similar Pro Select working directory.
The initial implementation can store runtime metadata separately from `.serena`.
We should avoid modifying unrelated OMA assets unless a shared fix is required for the planned scope.

alternatives.name: Embed `pros` into `oma`
alternatives.reason: Conflicts with the approved runtime separation and would blur your private authoring workflow with the end-user runtime.

alternatives.name: Make end users operate directly inside this source repo
alternatives.reason: Conflicts with the approved business-folder operating model and would couple production use to authoring assets.

alternatives.name: Create a separate `pros` source package in this repo
alternatives.reason: Preserves repo SSOT while allowing a distinct Windows-facing runtime and future packaging/export.
